messages.author: 3e06428f200265c8
messages.subject: Problem using facet_grid with geom_histogram
parts:
Hi all,

I'm having a problem with geom_histogram and facet_grid and I really don't know what's going on.

x <- data.frame(value=sample(10, 100, replace=T), group=sample(2, 100, replace=T))

ggplot(x, aes(value)) + geom_histogram()
This works correctly.

ggplot(x, aes(value)) + geom_histogram() + facet_grid(group ~ .)
However, this creates two plots with a max y axis of 1.  

How can I resolve this?

robbie
